Painter: Person who paints houses, buildings, walls and other surfaces.
Plumber: Person who installs, repairs and maintains water and plumbing systems.
Electrician: Person who installs, repairs and maintains electrical systems.
Carpenter: Person who makes and repairs wooden furniture and structures.
Mason: Person who works with bricks, concrete, stone and other building materials.
Gardener: Person who maintains gardens, plants, lawns and outdoor spaces.
Cleaner: Person who provides cleaning services for homes, offices and other places.
Mechanic: Person who repairs and maintains vehicles and mechanical systems.
